\section{Limits and concluding reformulation}

The operator-system substrate supplies a clean kinematic language, not a
Yang--Mills construction.  Completely positive maps do not automatically
encode relativistic locality, reflection positivity, asymptotic freedom,
topological completeness, or theory identity.  Those remain certificates to
be proved for the selected regulator and limit.

Likewise, the multi-star zero modes are not a polymer theorem; the topology
collision is not a topological sector-weight estimate; relative-entropy
identities are not quasi-factorization; finite partition refinement is not a
proof that a finite sufficient Yang--Mills boundary state exists; and a toy
OS semigroup is not a continuum reconstruction.

The programme's strongest conceptual compression is therefore
\begin{center}
\fbox{\parbox{0.84\linewidth}{\centering
The Yang--Mills mass gap is stable loss of nonvacuum relational information
under physical scale evolution, reconstructed as spectral rigidity.}}
\end{center}
This is an interpretation with a precise proposed mathematical carrier: a
complete, positive, normalized, multichannel transfer cocycle whose
nonvacuum sector is uniformly contractive in physical units.  Establishing
that carrier for four-dimensional pure Yang--Mills remains the central open
task.
